rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof shingles is direct property damage to the home structure.
claim_summary: Policyholder Jordan Lee (POL-1006) reports wind damage to approximately four roof shingles on the back porch overhang from this past weekend. No water intrusion occurred. Estimated repair cost is $400; however, the $2,500 deductible means this claim will likely not generate a payout.

case_facts.description: approximately four shingles blown off overhang above back porch
